title: BOOL_TO_INT, INT_TO_BOOL and ROUND
note: IEC 61131-3, data type conversion functions: TRUE converts to 1 and a non-zero integer to TRUE; ROUND (not an IEC function) returns a REAL holding the nearest integer: 2.4 gives 2.0, 2.6 gives 3.0 and -2.6 gives -3.0; midpoints are left out because their rounding is not defined by the standard
